environment.http_runtime_role: ctm_app: LOGIN NOSUPERUSER NOBYPASSRLS NOINHERIT. Runs 1-2: QA fixture table grants; runs 3-4: grants from migration 0038_runtime_grants only (58/60 tribunal tables forced RLS)

scenarios.title: Revise only when can_revise is true; newest answers/observations load
scenarios.expected: Author sees Revise only with literal can_revise:true; non-authors (member, secretary, admin, president) and applicant/secretary-authored reports show none; newest version content shown
scenarios.actual: API: can_revise true only for author on open own report; false for 4 other roles, applicant intake and secretary-authored report. UI: Revise shown/hidden accordingly with explanation; v2 content loaded.
scenarios.role: member (author), member, secretary, admin, president, applicant

scenarios.title: Successful edit persists through API and reload, one attributed version, prior values/files/non-text answers preserved
scenarios.expected: Saving from the council editor appends one attributed version over the real API; reload shows it; earlier versions, files and non-text answers retained
scenarios.actual: Run 4 (b3de51e): UI save appends one attributed version over the real API; reload/history correct; non-text answers kept; server refuses bodies without expected_version (422). Run 2 FAIL (council editor lacked expected_version) fixed in council be9f738.
scenarios.tests: api_scenarios.py S2 (incl. 'council editor request body'); browser_scenarios.py s2_edit_persist

scenarios.title: Unchanged save creates no unnecessary revision
scenarios.expected: No new version for an unchanged save
scenarios.actual: UI: 'Nothing has changed' notice, zero POSTs, no version (both runs). Server: an identical body with the current expected_version is still appended as a new version (observation; the editor prevents it).

scenarios.title: Other council member and non-author admin/secretary cannot revise; forged HTTP fails; read is not write
scenarios.expected: 403 for every non-author forged POST, no version created, GET still allowed
scenarios.actual: Run 2: all forged POSTs (member x2, secretary, admin, president, manager on secretary report) 403, unauthenticated/no-CSRF 403, no version, secretary GET 200; 0/16 denials as 404. Run 1: denied but 15/16 returned 404 resource_or_input_invalid (RLS hid the FOR UPDATE row) — fixed by bb3e48b's proceeding lock.

scenarios.title: Applicant/external original protected; applicant cannot call council revision endpoints
scenarios.expected: Council cannot rewrite applicant intake; applicant POST/GET on revision routes denied; applicant list leaks nothing
scenarios.actual: Manager/secretary/admin 403 on applicant intake; applicant 403 on own intake and council report revision routes and on council history GET; applicant list shows only own intake without can_revise/observations. External-priest reports not exercised (no external capability flow in QA-01 fixtures).

scenarios.title: Closed case/proceeding denies writes; reopening does not unlock old proceeding
scenarios.expected: 422 read-only for closed case and for original proceeding after reopening
scenarios.actual: Closed case: author and admin denied (422), can_revise false. Reopened (appeal-acceptance state): original-proceeding report can_revise false, write denied 422. DB trigger 'Closed proceedings are read only' also blocks raw INSERT.

scenarios.title: Reassignment does not let new manager rewrite; follow-up is its own report
scenarios.expected: Original author (no longer assigned) and new manager both denied; follow-up created as new linked report
scenarios.actual: Both 403 with can_revise false; new manager created/sent/completed a follow-up interview: separate report, parent_report_id = original, version 1, can_revise true for its author; original untouched.
scenarios.role: member (original author), member (new manager), secretary (recorded assignment), president (authorized)

scenarios.title: 403 / server error / lost acknowledgement: text survives, no false success, no silent duplicate or overwrite
scenarios.expected: Text kept, no success notice, retry does not duplicate
scenarios.actual: Run 4: simulated 500 -> 'server did not confirm' with text kept and no false success; lost acknowledgement -> server committed once, 'Try again' resends the identical body and is confirmed as the existing version (no duplicate); simulated 403 and real mid-edit reassignment 403 shown as denial with Save hidden. Server: identical retry returns same receipt; different body on old base 409.
scenarios.tests: api_scenarios.py S8; browser_scenarios.py s8_failures (500/403/lost-ack are simulated by Playwright interception and labelled; mid-edit reassignment is a real server denial)

scenarios.title: Two sessions save conflicting changes: server concurrency with real parallel requests
scenarios.actual: Run 4: real parallel POSTs [201, 409]; stale expected_version 409; browser: stale second session warned, near-simultaneous saves -> one version, no double success.

scenarios.title: Navigation/refresh warning preserves or handles unsaved narrative
scenarios.expected: Unsaved narrative warned or preserved on refresh and on in-app navigation
scenarios.actual: Run 4: refresh warns (beforeunload); sidebar navigation away and back restores the unsaved narrative with a notice. Runs 1-2 FAIL fixed in council 6937d54/87f094f.

scenarios.title: EN/AR, RTL, narrow viewport
scenarios.expected: Actual screens, correct author/history labels, no unauthorized controls or clipped fields
scenarios.actual: EN 390, AR 1280, AR 390: dir correct, Arabic author/revise labels, 0 overflow, 0 inline styles, textareas unclipped, no page errors; non-author in Arabic sees no Revise. Run 1 showed English punctuation mirrored inside RTL; fixed in 65fa389 (dir=auto + isolates).

scenarios.title: Role/scoping under non-owner PostgreSQL runtime role with audit/version evidence
scenarios.expected: HTTP runs as non-owner, RLS enforced below the API, history immutable, audit for each version
scenarios.actual: Server connected as ctm_app (rolsuper=false, rolbypassrls=false). Raw SQL as ctm_app: no actor context sees 0 revisions; unassigned member and applicant INSERT denied by RLS; closed/old-proceeding INSERT denied by trigger; in-place UPDATE denied ('historical records cannot be overwritten'); author INSERT positive control allowed (rolled back). Every appended version has a report_revised audit event.

scenarios.title: Returned correction resubmission with optional spouse DOB absent (governance run-4 handoff; backend #2 fix 48b80c4/0041)
scenarios.expected: Save, submit, replay, admin return, correction, resubmit without new signature/fee, replay; first submission frozen; party reference and case identity preserved; cross-applicant and member denials
scenarios.actual: Run 4 (b3de51e): 32/32 for applicant without spouse DOB and applicant with spouse DOB. Negative control on pre-fix 0b10a61: resubmission without spouse DOB returns HTTP 500 and the filing stays returned (29/32); with spouse DOB it passes.
scenarios.role: applicant x2, admin, member, other applicant
scenarios.tests: harness/returned_setup.py (owner, setup only); harness/returned_scenarios.py (HTTP as ctm_app)
